speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what are the main reasons for the low take-up rate for the Lease Buyback Scheme among owners of larger flats; (b) what are the measures being considered to increase the annual take-up rate beyond 1,500 households; and (c) whether there are any upcoming initiatives to assist homeowners in unlocking the value of their flats for retirement needs.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: In return, they receive a stream of income in their retirement years, while continuing to live in their flat.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Since then, we have made enhancements to the scheme.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: When it was first introduced, only owners of 3-room or smaller flats were eligible.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The scheme has since been expanded to owners of all flat types, including 5-room and larger flats.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: HDB reaches out to seniors on these housing monetisation options in various ways.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Besides publishing details of these options on the HDB InfoWEB, HDB also works with media outlets to raise awareness of these schemes alongside public talks, seminars and mini exhibitions at local community events.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: For example, there was a community event covering housing options for our seniors at Fengshan Community Club on 10 March 2023.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Moreover, CPF Board invites members turning 55 and 65 years old to attend a CPF Retirement Planning Service, which includes sharing on available housing monetisation options.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Order of the day.

speaker: Mr Speaker
